entries.back_en: Look at what you've become. Look at yourselves and tell me if you recognize anything — anything at all.
As firstborn, I'm abandoning these ridiculous wars. I grant my territories and all my disciples, under one condition: redirect the souls to a planet of my choice.

You can continue receiving mercenaries, but only if they themselves choose to come. Don't worry, they'll have to pass a test to prove themselves worthy. You'll only receive soldiers capable of serving. I'll send them; what you do with them is your decision.
entries.note: 'serving you' rendered as 'servir' but meaning intact.
